title: loom oracle adapter output, protocol 3
description: The one document tools/oracle/adapter/oracle.lua writes per run. This file documents the contract; loom-parity-cli enforces it with a hand-written check (tools/parity-cli/src/oracle_output.rs), which also requires: error is null exactly when stage is done; settings is null only when stage is startup; main_output and breakdowns are present exactly when stage is done; breakdowns holds exactly the names in the manifest's adapter.breakdowns; $opaque names a key in adapter.opaque_keys; modules is sorted; shims names exactly the manifest's adapter.shims, in that order; partial is not empty when an Inflate call in the probe has an error. Protocol 2 (PR C2b) added shims and probe; protocol 3 (PR C3b+C4) added the variant_order shim and probe.variant_order.

stage.description: The stage reached: done, or the stage that failed.

source.description: lua: a Lua error (with traceback); prompt: PoB's error prompt (launch.promptMsg); pob: PoB's XML parser or root check; adapter: the adapter's own check.

partial.description: Reasons the result is incomplete: a shim the build needed failed (for example inflate: cannot load the zlib library). Empty: complete.

shims.description: The named headless shims (tools/oracle/adapter/shims.lua), in the manifest's order.

probe.description: What the shims did in this run.

inflate.description: Every call of the Inflate shim, in order (PoB inflates timeless jewel data when a build needs it).

variant_order.description: Game ids of the gem variant tables the variant_order shim iterated in sorted order, once each, in first-use order: gems saved without a variantId whose variant PoB would otherwise pick by pairs order (old-format Vaal gems with transfigured copies).

writes_refused.description: Paths PoB tried to open for writing, which the write guard refused (for example the jewel loader's .bin cache), in order.

modules.description: Every module PoB loaded through require, sorted.

replaces.description: The global the shim replaces (Inflate, pairs, io.open).

installed.description: Whether the shim works (inflate: zlib loaded).

detail.description: inflate: the zlib version, or why zlib did not load (without paths).

inflate_call.description: One Inflate call: the results are integers and error is null, or the results are null and error is a string.

adler32.description: The zlib stream's Adler-32 of the inflated bytes (checked by zlib).

trailing_bytes.description: Input bytes after the end of the zlib stream.

value.description: A Lua value written as data. Numbers are written with %.17g (exact for a double); null never occurs.

table.description: A Lua table that is not a sequence 1..n (an empty table is {}, so an empty list and an empty map read alike). Number keys are written as # followed by the number (#inf and #-inf for infinities). String keys never start with $ or #.

placeholder.description: A value that is not data, written as a one-key object instead of being dropped.

oneOf.description: A PoB class instance (a table with a metatable), by class name.
A table under a key listed in the manifest's adapter.opaque_keys.
A table already open on the current path, by that path.
